whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a PEP 508 git URL in `project.dependencies`.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a PEP 508 git URL in `project.dependencies`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pyproject.toml no longer carries a PEP 508 git URL in `project.dependencies`.
